prompt: What BifrOSt version is running and how many windows are open? Answer in one line.
Which process on the machine uses the most memory (resident)? Give its command name and size.
What time does the menu bar clock show right now? Reply with just HH:MM.
Open the Calculator app and compute 1234 + 5678 in it (operate the app itself, not a shell). Report the number the Calculator displays.
In the Notes app, create a new note whose text is exactly: Þórður ætlar í bæinn {nonce}
Open the Clock app through Search (the keyboard shortcut and the search field), not through any launcher tool.
Open Settings, go to the Displays page, and tell me the display resolution it shows.
Create the file /tmp/mcp-eval.txt on the machine containing the single line: {nonce}
Look at the Files window and tell me the name of the folder it is showing (the window title or the selected sidebar item).
Write the line {nonce} to the system journal (logger), then use the logs tool twice: once to establish a cursor before and once after. Report the line that the second logs call returned as new.
Were there any crashes (coredumps or shell panics) on this boot? Answer 'none' or name the crashed program.

check.answer_has_exec: coredumpctl list --no-pager --no-legend --since -1d 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | awk '{print $NF}' | xargs -r basename | grep . || echo none

prompt: Upload a file /tmp/mcp-dev-{nonce}.txt containing exactly the text {nonce} followed by a newline, using the dev tool, and report the sha256 it returned.
Using the perf tool, which process uses the most CPU right now? Give its command name.
Using the app tool in describe mode, which methods does the notes app expose? List three.
Restart the notes app with the dev tool, then use wait (app_ready) until it answers. Report how many ms it took.
Take a screenshot of the notes app by app id (it may be covered or minimized). Report the image size in pixels.
